summary: First Kota-OS website pilot release for South African food businesses, with offline operations, direct Paystack billing, business backup and device-specific Android installers.
features: Run sales, menu, ingredient inventory and reporting operations with offline-first support.
Start with a 14-day trial and manage subscription access through Paystack on the website edition.
Export and restore business backups for device recovery.
Register verified business devices with account-level device controls.
Delete a Kota-OS account and associated cloud data directly from the app.
Receive app update information through the Kota-OS version service.
Improved layouts for compact phones, rotated devices and larger Android screens.
Separate ARM64 and ARMv7 Android installers for improved device compatibility and smaller downloads.
fixes: Removed the unavailable WhatsApp verification fallback from onboarding.
Improved account recovery and deletion flows.
Separated website and store distribution update channels.
